description.zh:
证书类型，当前仅支持**custom**，表示使用自定义证书。
> **SSLEnabled**为**1**时，此参数必须配置。
description.en:
The certificate type. Currently, only **custom** is supported, which indicates that a custom certificate is used.
> This parameter is required when **SSLEnabled** is set to **1**.
The instance ID of the AI application.

description.zh:
开启或关闭SSL，取值：
* **1**：开启
* **0**：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable SSL. Valid values:
* **1**: Enable SSL.
* **0**: Disable SSL.

description.zh:
自定义证书内容。

> **CAType**为**custom**时，此参数必须配置。
description.en:
The content of the custom certificate.

> This parameter is required when **CAType** is set to **custom**.

description.zh:
证书私钥。

> **CAType**为**custom**时，此参数必须配置。
description.en:
The private key of the certificate.

> This parameter is required when **CAType** is set to **custom**.

title.zh: 修改RDS AI应用实例SSL配置
title.en: Modify SSL configuration of an RDS AI application instance
